meta.title: Kent Shen — Workbench
meta.description: A workbench for small, useful things — Chrome extensions, apps, games, and web services built by Kent Shen.

ui.colophon: Set in Noto Serif TC & Zen Kaku Gothic New. Built by hand, no framework.

products.title: TAIWAN-BAIYUE
products.desc: A full **Leaflet** map tool for Taiwan's 100 Peaks — satellite imagery, a filter panel, a hiking checklist, a "dice roll" random-peak picker, and live weather from Taiwan's CWA via a Cloudflare Worker.

products.title: TW-STOCK-REPORT
products.desc: One-click fetch of the latest **TW and US** stock fundamentals — P/E, P/B, dividend yield, gross margin, pre-tax margin, YoY revenue growth — auto-scored into an investment score and health rating, with CSV/JSON export.

products.title: UNDERCURRENT
products.desc: A corporate relationship-graph **due-diligence** tool — search by name, company, or business ID to trace directors, managers, and cross-company shareholding chains. Pulls from Taiwan's official **GCIS** registry, foundation/association filings, news, court judgment lookups, and environmental penalty records, with PNG/CSV export.

products.title: ELSEWHERE
products.desc: An AI trip planner covering 171 countries — pick a destination on a spinning 3D globe. Japan/Korea/Vietnam/Thailand use a **database-backed precision mode** (real attractions, restaurants, and hotels, not AI-invented ones); other countries draw on the AI's own knowledge. Drag-to-reorder itinerary editing, Google Maps route overlays, and shareable short links.
